hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); py=$(command -v python3 || command -v python || true); if [ -n "$py" ]; then "$py" "$r/.codex/hooks/_run.py" session_start >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; exit 0'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $r = (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) } catch { $r = $null }; if (-not $r) { $r = (Get-Location).Path }; try { python (Join-Path $r '.codex/hooks/_run.py') session_start | Out-Null } catch { }; exit 0"
